name: Quiet time fades an excited Boop a step at a time
case: Boop is excited when a quick turn finishes, and then nothing happens for hours, with the session still open. Boop's idle check-ins let its mood fade a step at a time once its minutes are up: to happy first (excited has no move straight to calm), then calm. By half an hour it's happy or calm, and two hours on it's calm.
why: characters/boop/steering/guide.md: after the minutes MOOD gives a mood fades a step toward calm, at the next pass, which while you're around is an idle check-in; the mood graph has no move from excited to calm, so it goes through happy (characters/boop/steering/mood/excited.md)
